title: Largest Triangle Area
summary: Given an array of points on the X-Y plane, where each point is represented as [xi, yi], determine the area of the largest triangle that can be formed by any three distinct points.
statement: Given an array of points on the X-Y plane, where each point is represented as [xi, yi], determine the area of the largest triangle that can be formed by any three distinct points. Acceptable answers are within 10^-5 of the true area.
constraints: Return the maximum area of a triangle formed by any three points.
hints: The cross-product magnitude of two side vectors equals twice the triangle area.
Enumerate every point triple and maximize absolute determinant divided by two.
Every candidate triangle appears once, and the determinant formula is orientation-independent after absolute value.
editorial: Every candidate triangle appears once, and the determinant formula is orientation-independent after absolute value.

tests.explanation: The right triangle with legs two has area two.
A unit right triangle has area one half.
